title: telemetry-conventions
description: Naming convention for traces and metrics of the modules: the span names and their nesting, the attributes with their cardinality, and the rule for metric labels. Data lives in configs/telemetry-conventions.json; the API is aicore.util.telemetry.

namespace.description: Prefix of every span and attribute name defined here; attributes of the OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions keep their gen_ai. prefix.

name.description: Span name, lower case with dots, starting with the namespace.

parent.description: Name of the span this one runs inside, or null for a root span.

genai.description: Name template of the OpenTelemetry GenAI span this one also is, with one {placeholder} for the agent or tool name, or null.

attributes.description: The attributes a span or a metric may carry.

name.description: Attribute name, lower case with dots, starting with the namespace.

cardinality.description: low: a small fixed set of values, fit for a metric label; high: unbounded values such as ids, for spans and logs only.

metric_label_rule.description: Only attributes declared with low cardinality may be metric labels.
